name: ch-ai-resume-api-gcp
description: Cloud Function (2nd gen) behind Firebase Hosting (/api/resume/request) that gates the resume download: validates + captchas the submission, logs a telemetry row to Firestore, and returns a short-lived V4 signed GCS URL.

scripts.package: rm -f dist.zip && node write-deploy-package-json.js && cd dist && zip -X -r ../dist.zip . && cd ..
